units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 108a:8">B. Mets. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מאן דאחזיק בר׳ דנהרא וכ׳</he> he who takes possession of the alluvial ground of a river (or canal) is considered an impudent man, but cannot be removed.
<cite ref="Sukkah 26a:3">Succ. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו גנו אר׳ דסורא</he> they used to sleep on a bank of Sura.

<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:12">Bets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ דפרת</he> the clayey alluvium of the Euphrates; a. e.—[<cite ref="Bava Batra 26a:2">B. Bath. 26ᵃ</cite> top <cite ref="T01057"><he>רקתא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="D01022"><he>דַקְתָּא</he></cite>.]
